posts.text:
Trade: The Colts are trading 3-time Pro-Bowl DT DeForest Buckner back to the 49ers, the team that made him a 2016 first-round pick before dealing him to Indianapolis in 2020, per me and Adam Schefter. A reunion!!

Now Buckner returns to SF, fortifying their defensive line.

posts.author: RotoWire
posts.text: NFL Injury Report & Analysis Week 8: Amon-Ra St. Brown Ankle Tweak - RotoWire

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade: The Colts are sending eight-time Pro-Bowl guard Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks, per Adam Schefter and me. 

Nelson is on an expiring contract and the Colts get back draft capital now before they could lose him in free agency. A Colts legend goes to the champs.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Ravens first-round guard Vega Ioane, one of the NFL’s best rookies this season, suffered an MCL sprain against the Bengals, sources tell me and Mike Garafolo.

It’s considered to be a short-term injury, though he will miss a little time.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Raiders coach Klint Kubiak made clear that “there is no controversy” — Kirk Cousins will start this week. 

As for Fernando Mendoza, “Fernando is going to play at some point, but it’s not going to be this week.”

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Seahawks OT Charles Cross, who suffered an ankle injury on Sunday, has a high-ankle sprain and will miss time, the MRI revealed.

The hope is he’s back in 1-2 weeks, but it depends on how rehab goes.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Packers LB Zaire Franklin, who missed last week’s game after getting accidentally kicked in practice, suffered a hairline fracture in his leg, sources say.

Green Bay did not place him on Injured Reserve, and they believe he can return while missing minimal games.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Patriots are releasing their punter from the previous three seasons, Bryce Baringer, source says. He’s been on Injured Reserve, but is healthy now.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Packers C Sean Rhyan, who left Sunday’s game with an ankle injury, is believed to have suffered a high-ankle sprain, sources say. 

X-Rays were negative, and he has an MRI today. But high-ankle sprains are often 4-6 week injuries

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Earning back his spot.

posts.text:
Eagles RB Will Shipley suffered a partial tear to his plantar fascia in Sunday’s loss to the Jaguars, per sources.

Shipley started in the absence of Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigsby. Now another RB injury, though there’s optimism Barkley will be back soon.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Rams signed veteran LB Eric Kendricks to the practice squad.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson (ankle) for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers principal owner Jed York has been suspended for six regular-season games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy, the NFL announced today.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

Reddit's public JSON endpoints have contested availability in 2026 (some reports say ~60 req/min unauthenticated, others say broadly blocked with 403 since May 2026), so an unreachable probe here is expected and is not treated as a pipeline failure.
